name: mcp-azeth
description: Trust infrastructure for the machine economy. Gives AI agents non-custodial smart accounts (ERC-4337), x402 payments, on-chain reputation via ERC-8004 trust registry, and service discovery. 8 tools: create accounts, transfer, check balances, pay for x402 services, publish/discover services, manage payment agreements, and send encrypted messages.

PIMLICO_API_KEY.description: Pimlico bundler API key. Falls back to Azeth server bundler proxy if not set.

AZETH_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Account owner's private key. Auto-generated and saved to ~/.azeth/key if not set.

AZETH_GUARDIAN_KEY.description: Separate guardian key for co-signing high-value operations.

XMTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: For persistent XMTP messaging across restarts.

AZETH_RPC_URL_ETH_SEPOLIA.description: Custom RPC endpoint for Ethereum Sepolia.

AZETH_RPC_URL_BASE_SEPOLIA.description: Custom RPC endpoint for Base Sepolia.
